derivation.critical_mapping: EXP-183 identifies the unimodal critical with the higher-coordinate trimodal critical K1; the other lower-coordinate critical K0 is therefore D.
derivation.B0_to_2: With K0=D below K1=C, B0 is the outer interval on the far side of the new critical D from retained C and is therefore the newly opened third branch.
derivation.B2_to_0: B2 is predicted to be the innermost return interval; this must be tested using physical distance to the small equilibrium in fresh trajectories.
derivation.B1_to_1: B1 is the only remaining interval after the independently defined third and inner intervals are assigned.

allowed_inputs: author prose defining C, D, the third-branch excursion, and inner deposition
